images.caption:
Views of the stunning beach at Marina San Francesco in Sorrento from Villa Comunale in Sorrento.
This was my first look at it, although we would return here later in the week (the morning before we flew home).
You can see the beach at Marina San Francesco, and the port at Marina Piccola.
Views of the beach. I think these look amazing! I later found similar ones in Amalfi.

Coin-operated telescope - for those without cameras? Who uses these, these days if you've got a camera to take the view home with you!
